output.title: Vault issuer config not used in this environment
output.content: This change adds a server-name configuration option to the Vault issuer. The environment manifests show Certificate resources in use but no evidence of Vault issuers (ClusterIssuer or Issuer with vault provider). The values and manifest apiVersions do not indicate Vault issuer deployment. This feature does not apply to environments not using the Vault issuer.
